name: Norse mythology
hook: Thor's hammer, Odin's ravens and Loki's tricks cover most Norse myth clues.

facts.label: Odin
facts.statement: Odin is the top god, or Allfather, of Asgard. His ravens Huginn (thought) and Muninn (memory) fly over the nine worlds and bring him news.

facts.label: Thor
facts.statement: Thor is the thunder god whose hammer, Mjolnir, Vikings wore as protective pendants. His realm in Asgard is Thrudheim, the "Place of Might."

facts.label: Loki
facts.statement: Loki is the trickster god who engineered Balder's death with mistletoe and often appeared as an old woman.

facts.label: Balder
facts.statement: Balder is the beautiful, beloved son of Odin and Frigg; all things swore not to harm him except mistletoe, the plant that killed him.

facts.label: Fenrir
facts.statement: Fenrir is the giant wolf who will swallow Odin at Ragnarok, the final battle.

facts.label: Valhalla
facts.statement: Valhalla is Odin's great hall where slain heroes feast and revel; the boar Saehrimnir is always the main course.

facts.label: Sleipnir
facts.statement: Sleipnir is the horse that carried Odin to the underworld; a feature on Pluto is named Sleipnir Fossa after it.
